title: Singleton-indicator Fourier projection
statement: Let $\mathcal F$ be a finite family of subsets of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ and let $a\in\{−1,1\}^n$. The singleton-indicator Fourier projection is the function sending $x\in\{−1,1\}^n$ to $\sum_{S\in\mathcal F}\widehat{\mathbf 1_{\{a\}}}(S)\,\chi_S(x)$, where $\widehat{\mathbf 1_{\{a\}}}(S)$ is the Fourier coefficient at $S$ of the indicator of the singleton $\{a\}$ and $\chi_S(x)=\prod_{i\in S}x_i$.
